visualCharacteristics.purpose: Client-side Waist-to-Height Ratio calculator with optional info tooltip, metric/imperial toggle, height and waist inputs, ratio result and health-risk category; nothing is submitted
visualCharacteristics.layout: light green card: heading, optional tooltip and unit switch in a header row, height and waist inputs side by side from 900px, speech-bubble tail pointing at the navy Calculate button aligned right, result below

contentPattern.structure: key/value rows. Title | heading text (or a heading row); Info | tooltip button label | tooltip text (optional); Metric | label; Imperial | label; Units label | optional legend; Height | label; Waist | label; Metric units | "cm" (or "cm, cm" for height, waist); Imperial units | "ft, in, in" (height ft, height in, waist in); Button | button label; Result | result prefix e.g. "Your Waist-to-Height Ratio is"; Error | message when inputs are missing; Field error | optional short message next to an empty field label e.g. "Input required"; Category | category name | upper ratio limit (exclusive, empty for the last one) | optional description. Any other single-cell row is shown as intro text
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Interactive Waist-to-Height Ratio calculator: heading "Check your Waist-to-Height Ratio", optional "Why do I need to calculate this?" tooltip, metric/imperial toggle, height (cm | ft + in) and waist circumference (cm | in) inputs, Calculate button

usage: Waist-to-Height Ratio page (on white) and heart-health page (in a light-grey section, with the tooltip).
reuseGuidance: All labels, units, the tooltip and categories are authored, so the block can be localised per market without code changes. Put it in a light-grey section (Section Metadata style light-grey) when it should sit on a grey panel.
